about: The 14 content formats from John's creative brief (21 Nov 2026, .github/SOCIAL.md). 'formats' = WHAT a post is; 'styles' = HOW it looks (engine styles). The planner keeps the 14-post mix close to 'mix', rotates formats, and leans towards formats that earn saves, shares and clicks (content-learning.json). The channel scout reviews this file every fortnight (formats and memes move fast): status 'active', 'trial' (new, given a fair go), 'tired' (used less) or 'retired' (not used), with 'review' notes.

formats.name: Golf comedy sketch
formats.note: Text-led sketches with obviously fictional characters; real filmed skits come from John (the pack suggests two a week).

formats.name: Reaction / hot take
formats.note: Opinions on launches and prices; brands may be named in opinions, retailers never; no attacks on people.

formats.name: Mini golf drama
formats.note: Episodic, recurring fictional characters (see bank 'characters'); one episode a fortnight at most.

formats.name: Myth buster
formats.note: Only myths from the vetted bank, or ones our own price data settles.

formats.name: Community / UGC
formats.note: Questions and polls only. Never invent a golfer's story, comment or review; real UGC is used only with the person's permission.

formats.name: Trending culture remix
formats.note: Only with a real, verified trend (newsroom, moments planner or trends scout). Never invent a trend or a sound.

formats.name: Golf confession / storytime
formats.note: Real stories only (John's own, or followers' with permission). The engine never writes one as if it happened.

series.name: The Fourball
series.about: Weekly episode of the recurring cast (Big Dave, Phil, Steady Steve, Gaz, Kev). Episodes post in order.

visualStyles.humour: Style A: golf humour. Photo, dark green brush banner set-up, yellow punchline banner with arrow.
visualStyles.headline: Style B: big headline. Photo, oversized white and yellow headline, green banner.
visualStyles.carousel: 5 to 7 slides, 1080x1350: Style B cover, numbered green slides, yellow save slide.

review.why: Relatable memes still core. 'Me when...' and 'Tell me you're X without telling me' are listed as fading; POV, expectation v reality and 'this is your sign' are peaking or rising. Lean the new lines that way.
Cold-opening the funniest beat and opening inside the conflict are working; proposed 'payoff-first-cut'.
Episodic series and microdramas growing fast (YouTube 6.5bn microdrama views H1 2026; short-drama app downloads up 95.5% H1 2026). Keep on trial until our own numbers come in.
'Unpopular opinion' framing is peaking on TikTok; plain reaction videos are fading. Write hot takes as 'unpopular opinion:' not reactions.
Carousels reported as outperforming video on saves and shares; Instagram now allows a caption per slide and up to 20 slides.
No change; 'This is your sign' rising, which suits challenge hooks.

Buffer (2.7m Reels, Jan-Aug 2026): Reels under 15s reached 1.5% below accounts' baseline, 90-179s 7.4% above; only Reels of 3 minutes or less go to non-followers. Trend formats themselves run 5-15s. Mix and lengths unchanged; worth testing a 60-90s Fourball season recap once we have several episodes.
